column1: # Rows db.ps15b2.* (line PS, PS15b-2): psiblast's query-anchored reports (outfmt 1 to 4, each round's sections, the epilog of outfmt 0), the JSON Seq-aligns of each round (12) and the organism report of each round (18, from the uncut lists) for a FASTA query at -num_iterations 0 to 6, -in_pssm (text and binary, the molecule other, a local id), -in_msa, with -db (tests/db_search/paja and others) and -subject; NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 `psiblast ... -num_threads 1`. A PSSM query of the molecule other writes a line feed for each query-anchored section where NCBI's merge of the HSPs (the query read as a nucleotide sequence) returns, and LOSAT's refusal after the report before the section where it throws or crashes (rows db.ps15b2.p.othr.*). Freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.ps15b2.`.
